notes: Announced Jul 24, 2025; India first sale Jul 30 (launch ~Rs 31,999; ~Rs 26,999 street Jun 2026). Brazil launch CORRECTED: official BR launch was Oct 2025 (Tecnoblog/Mobilebit, R$ 4,999 launch; not Aug 2025 as previously recorded). 50MP main OIS + 50MP UW 116° f/2.0 (GSMArena-confirmed) — one of the few 50MP ultrawides in this price band. realme UI 7.0 (A16) rollout for the 15 series scheduled Q1/Q2 2026.
caveats: realme/ColorOS is a known-restricted OEM for third-party Camera2 aux access (GCam package-name workarounds explicitly do not work on realme); CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO lower bound on the logical back camera is likely 1.0 — UW reachability MUST be confirmed by runtime probe. 116° advertised is in the marginal 112-117 band; computed dFOV after distortion correction may land lower. Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 encoder is reliable (Qualcomm CBR documented). Not yet found on the ARCore certified list (device may be too new) — timestamp source unverified. Efficient 4nm SoC + 7000mAh: thermal headroom good on paper.

notes: India launch Jan 6, 2026 (Rs 31,999 at launch). 200MP main OIS + 8MP UW 112°. Ships on Android 16 / realme UI 7.0. India prices revised upward (~Rs 4,000) from Feb 11, 2026. Brazil got the base 16 5G and the 16 Pro+ (May 2026), but NOT the 16 Pro — confirmed via BR launch coverage.

No ARCore certification evidence; midrange MTK tier is where REALTIME timestamp source and sustained 100 Hz IMU most often break.

notes: India Apr 2022 (Rs 49,999); Brazil May 18, 2022 at R$5,999 (promo R$4,999). 50MP IMX766 OIS + 50MP JN1 150° fisheye-grade ultrawide + 3MP microscope — the widest UW FOV in the whole realme slice. caveats: Best-credentialed realme in this batch: ARCore-certified, flagship Qualcomm encoder, 150° UW with huge FOV margin. Two real risks: (1) realme Camera2 aux restriction — the 150° JN1 may be invisible to third-party Camera2 (runtime probe required), and even if reachable the fisheye-grade distortion correction may materially change the deliverable dFOV/geometry; (2) Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 is the most throttle-notorious modern Qualcomm SoC — 25-min sustained 1080p30 capture must be smoke-tested. Do not promote to Supported without an on-device probe.
